verdict.rationale: Linear is an issue and project tracker, so switching between view layouts is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents board, list, calendar, or timeline layouts, or switching between them. Mentions of shareable filtered views, subscribing to project views and strategic roadmaps are adjacent features and do not show multiple layouts over the same work.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
